name: Aegis Link Cleaner
description: Strips tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, etc.) from navigation URLs.
notes: Permission justification: webRequest, webRequestBlocking, and <all_urls> are broad permissions that grant full HTTP request interception and rewriting rights. This is intentionally NOT least privilege: these permissions are strictly required because declarativeNetRequest (DNR) static rules in Gecko ESR 153 cannot express prefix matching (utm_*, pk_*, mtm_*, hsa_*) or dynamic per-site/per-domain keep-lists. Operates strictly offline with zero external network access (Privacy Class P0).
